settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Dolphins and Colts, scheduled for November 15 at 1:00PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Dolphins" if Dolphins win the game.
This market will resolve to "Colts" if Colts win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Vikings and Packers, scheduled for November 15 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Packers" if the Packers win the game by 5 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Vikings".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

teamAlerts.name: Jacoby Brissett
teamAlerts.detail: Ahead of Week 10, Ravens head coach Jesse Minter noted "I expect (Brissett) to be our starter" next Monday against the Chargers, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

teamAlerts.name: Lamar Jackson
teamAlerts.detail: Jackson, who is scheduled to undergo surgery on his injured right thumb, has told teammates he plans to return later this season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

teamAlerts.name: Joe Fagnano

teamAlerts.name: Tyler Huntley
teamAlerts.detail: Huntley (toe) was placed on injured reserve Thursday.

teamAlerts.name: Justin Herbert
teamAlerts.detail: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said that Herbert "should be good to go" for Monday's game at Baltimore after imaging on the quarterback's injured left middle finger returned negative for a fracture, ESPN.com reports.
